summary.en: Chinese bomber activity near the Philippine coast and a Chinese plane in the West Philippine Sea continue, while the Armed Forces observed 48 Chinese Coast Guard and PLA Navy vessels across four key features, more than double the prior count. The Philippine Coast Guard commissioned three locally built survey ships and three new vessels, including BRP Patag, BRP Pag-asa and BRP Kalikasan, alongside US patrol boats. Joint naval exercises were held with France in the Sulu Sea and a partnership with Japan supplied five new Coast Guard vessels. The conflict still records 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesisk bomberaktivitet nær den filippinske kysten og et kinesisk fly i Vestfilippinene fortsetter, mens de væpnede styrkene observerte 48 kinesiske kystvaktskip og PLA-marineskip på fire viktige områder, mer enn dobbelt så mange som tidligere. Filippinernes kystvakt satte i drift tre lokalt bygde kartleggingsskip og tre nye fartøy, inkludert BRP Patag, BRP Pag-asa og BRP Kalikasan, sammen med amerikanske patruljebåter. Felles marineøvelser ble holdt med Frankrike i Sulusjøen, og et samarbeid med Japan leverte fem nye kystvaktskip. Konflikten registrerer fortsatt 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
